name: JobRunnerWriteRunning
note: No expected-state guard; terminalPublished is a history observer for this attempt.

name: JobRunnerFailureStop
note: Stop is sent only when server run_processes contains the job; it does not reclaim reservations.

name: JobRunnerFailureStatus
note: Failure-branch store failure is TV-2 first, not injected here.

name: StartJobProcessorRejectToken
note: Fixed missing-token rejection; no fallback allocation and no rollback when allocation never succeeded.

name: ClientEngineStartAppCheck
note: Valid fresh start after acknowledged deployment; early-return alternative is preserved separately.

name: ClientEngineStartAppReturnedError
note: CR-1 boundary: cannot be reached by the selected successful-deploy START chain. No arbitrary deletion fault added; returned error does not free allocation.

name: JobExecutorPrepareException
note: Ordinary preparation/metadata I/O exception before spawn; no fabricated invalid input.

name: ProcessJobLauncherSpawnException
note: Failure before a returned live handle; post-spawn handle-constructor failure is outside this slice.

name: JobExecutorAfterJobLaunchEvent
note: Real event dispatch catches ordinary handler exceptions; no exceptional rollback edge from such handlers.

name: JobExecutorWaiterInstallationException
note: Ordinary Thread construction/start exception before waiter execution. Live attached handle is retained; no invented double-free thread.

name: StartJobProcessorRollback
note: Rollback calls free(payload) regardless of child liveness or handle ownership. No fictitious token guard on free.

name: ClientChildExit
note: Ordinary completion or response to a stop; no guaranteed success under a permanently non-terminating process.

name: ClientChildFailure
note: Abstract reportable ordinary process failure; generic teardown RC classifications are not expanded.

name: JobExecutorOutcomeReportReturned
note: Reply success or already consumed/lost request followed by return; ReportTimeout covers still-in-flight requests.

name: JobExecutorOutcomeReportException
note: Report exception/timeout is caught; it never bypasses normal resource release.

name: JobExecutorFreeAfterExit
note: Uses retained payload; deliberately no allocated/token test that would conceal repeated free.

name: JobExecutorJobCompletedEvent
note: Site-local completion event does not call the server scheduler. Explicit job identity is preserved.

name: ClientEngineAbortApp
note: At executor abort ownership update under lock, or ClientEngine no-op early return; termination and wait completion are separate.

name: ClientEngineHeartbeatAbort
note: At executor abort ownership update under lock, or ClientEngine no-op early return; termination and wait completion are separate.

name: JobExecutorTerminateAfterGrace
note: 10s bounded graceful wait before terminate; physical process exit remains separate.

name: FederatedServerHeartbeatCleanup
note: Outcome-map key protects normally completing jobs even when pending set is empty. Repeated heartbeat requests never free resources. Normal periodic response; not an injected, exhaustible fault.

name: ServerEngineReceiveOutcome
note: Idempotent discard for exact job/site. Receiver authentication and reporter classification are boundary assumptions.

name: ServerEngineReceiveFailureOutcome

note: Authoritative failure bypasses the outcome barrier. Late failure after final removal does not resurrect a job.

name: ServerEngineObserveExit
note: Includes finite <=2s UPDATE_RUN_STATUS grace; process already exited.

name: ServerEngineTerminateAfterGrace
note: The full 10-second grace branch. Separate early-exit and command-error branches retain their actual deadlines; physical OS exit is independent. Multiple supported abort workers may repeat termination; serverTerminated records occurrence and is not a production guard.

name: ServerEngineRemoveAfterTerminate
note: CR-2 boundary retained. No injected permanently ineffective SIGKILL or process-count invariant. The final pop(job_id,None) may be a no-op after the exit waiter removed it.

name: JobCommandAbortPreRunAcknowledge
note: Acknowledges the saved branch, without rereading status or sending process stop.

name: JobRunnerMarkAborted

name: JobRunnerTerminalStoreException
